Administration of Criminal Justice is concerned with adjudication process, application of remedies to violated rights.

The judiciary is the branch of governance invested with judicial powers, the system of courts in a country, the body of judges (the bench).

Power means Authority to make certain orders and decisions with reference to the matter before the court.

institution known as the Judiciary is concerned, which vests in courts the judicial powers of the Federation was left extant".

A crime is a wrong other than a civil wrong.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Federation of 36 States and a Federal Capital Territory."
Modern Nigeria is a Federation of 36 States and a Federal Capital Territory.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an inquiry by a coroner into the manner of death of a person who has died under suspicious circumstances."
Inquest An inquest is an inquiry by a coroner into the manner of death of a person who has died under suspicious circumstances.
